scope: Finite control abstraction of .files onboarding and a distinct opt-in single-node K3s lifecycle. Requests never execute commands. General onboarding completion does not imply K3s installation; K3s entry switches the displayed lifecycle, not the machine's onboarding record. Repeated module selection abstracts the three recommended modules and four optional modules; native scripts retain their own details.
trustBoundary: Every fact is externally supplied for replay. Bend checks phase and supplied permission/evidence predicates, not their truth, freshness, identity binding, OS execution, firewall enforcement or Factory authority. Synthetic scenarios are not deployment receipts. No invariant theorem/proof suite is claimed; compilation/typechecking alone is not an invariant proof.

states.title: Open checkout
states.summary: No status observation yet. Phone is a controller; this diagram performs no native setup.

states.title: Status requested
states.summary: Read onboard status --json; await an external result. Status request establishes no completion.

states.title: Ask before setup
states.summary: Recommended baseline incomplete: ask explicitly whether to run onboarding.

states.title: Select one module
states.summary: Explicitly approved guided setup. Select core-links, fonts, agent-skills, or separately confirmed optional agent-tools/tailnet-ssh/nix-home/audio-evolution. K3s is not a module.

states.title: Module requested
states.summary: Await result of only the selected module; success bookkeeping is not full external verification.

states.title: Recommended complete
states.summary: External status reports core-links + fonts + agent-skills done or done-inferred. Do not automatically re-offer; doctor/optional modules remain available. This says nothing about K3s.

states.title: Setup deferred
states.summary: User declined onboarding. No module runs; later explicit setup remains possible.

states.title: K3s opt-in recorded
states.summary: Separate user choice only. Phone/Android/proot and MacBook cannot host this server; use confirmed native Groot desktop and keep credentials there.

citations.symbol: Phone first / Desktop server / MacBook client

states.title: Read-only preflight requested
states.summary: Authenticated native host runs --check with discovered private node IP and reviewed firewall policy. No downloads, staging, writes or service restart.

states.title: Fresh install eligible
states.summary: Supplied preflight observation passed all gates, with no changed/foreign installation. Still not installed; explicit --apply required with same approved flags. Facts must be refreshed externally before apply.

states.title: Apply requested · not success
states.summary: Request pinned verified installer/binary, private staging and atomic config publication. Ownership marker may survive startup failure; request alone proves no installation/readiness.

states.title: Managed API ready observed
states.summary: External observation binds matching managed state, active service and ready private API. An exact managed rerun checks without reinstall/restart. Namespace boundary is not applied automatically.

states.title: Boundary apply requested
states.summary: Separately approved explicit-context namespace manifest apply. Configured desired state is not actual enforcement evidence.

states.title: Boundary applied observed
states.summary: Shared namespace/SA/quota/LimitRange/PSA/default-deny objects observed. Six-Pod quota and ingress/egress enforcement still need runtime controls.

states.title: Bounded smoke requested
states.summary: Approved quiet namespace and explicit context; uniquely named probes/Job, scoped cleanup only, no Factory lease or authorization. Capture evidence privately.

states.title: Runtime evidence observed · await TTL
states.summary: Job Complete alone is insufficient: supplied retained evidence includes source hashes/context, successful container results for EVERY captured Pod, actual imageID, exit/node/timestamps/logs, verified live quota AND LimitRange, seventh-Pod denial and independent network controls. Cleanup under the reviewed live TTL remains unobserved.

citations.symbol: live prerequisite checks / source / quota_seventh_pod_denied / network controls / container_result

states.title: Bounded runtime acceptance
states.summary: Retained evidence plus matching reviewed live TTL and Job AND dependent Pod disappearance observed without helper deletion. This is cleanup under that TTL configuration, not an exclusive-cause controller audit. Infrastructure smoke only: no universal network/sandbox guarantee, production deployment, contribution acceptance or Factory authorization.

states.title: Blocked / manual review
states.summary: Storage/auth/network/firewall/host failure, partial startup, changed/foreign ownership or later drift. No overwrite, adoption, automatic cleanup or restart. Retain ownership marker and working Tern access.

states.title: Destructive rollback requested
states.summary: Only explicit destructive approval after backup, Factory workload stop and killall/uninstall network impact review. Exact approved K3S_DATA_DIR; never namespace deletion as smoke cleanup.

states.title: Rollback observed
states.summary: External observation reports approved teardown complete. No automatic reinstall or assertion host networking/other services are healthy.

states.title: Reviewed start requested
states.summary: Exact owned inactive service only, cause reviewed and start explicitly approved. Await new startup/API observation; --apply rerun is never a recovery restart.

events.title: Observe cleanup under reviewed live TTL

facts.title: External observation supplied
facts.description: Host result supplied by observer, not manufactured by a request.

facts.title: Recommended status complete
facts.description: onboard status reports core-links/fonts/agent-skills done or done-inferred; not OS-wide health.

facts.title: Explicit approval for this action
facts.description: Scoped selection/consent, not blanket authorization for later optional or destructive actions.

facts.title: Native desktop host verified
facts.description: Supported Linux/systemd x86_64, not Android/proot/container/laptop; cgroup v2, memory and tools satisfy bootstrap.

facts.title: Approved host admin authenticated
facts.description: Human-approved desktop root/sudo session; no hidden escalation or credential copies.

facts.title: Root/kubelet/data storage gates passed
facts.description: Each byte filesystem >5% free plus 1 GiB reserve; inode >5% plus 1000 (Btrfs zero-inode special reporting); dedicated path reviewed. No deletion implicitly approved.

facts.title: Private address / network reviewed
facts.description: Assigned private node IP, CIDRs/routes/ports and tailnet ACL/netfilter ordering reviewed; UFW alone is not tailnet isolation.

facts.title: Supported UFW policy verified
facts.description: Active deny incoming/allow outgoing; dedicated cni0 rules and reviewed narrow SSH; preserve access, never auto-reset.

facts.title: Fresh or exact managed ownership safe
facts.description: No foreign/partial state, changed config/binary/service/settings or competing agent. No silent adoption.

facts.title: Exact managed installation verified
facts.description: Matching ownership/hashes/permissions/settings; ownership marker alone insufficient.

facts.title: Live boundary apply result observed
facts.description: Desired manifests exist in checkout is NOT this fact; enforcement is tested separately.

facts.title: Quiet namespace window approved
facts.description: Existing authority paused submissions; no nonterminal workers, no invented scheduler/lease.

facts.title: Runtime evidence retained privately
facts.description: Actual source hashes/dirty commit/context, timestamped logs, full Job/Pod status, actual imageID, zero exit, node and timing bound to this run. EVERY captured Pod supplies successful container results; live ResourceQuota AND LimitRange match the shared boundary. Missing status or drifted limits invalidates this fact. Never secrets in Git.

facts.title: Independent network controls verified
facts.description: Real positive TCP connectivity; ingress and egress negative controls independently timeout against a running server; restored allowance restores connectivity. Not universal isolation.

facts.title: Job AND Pod cleanup under reviewed TTL
facts.description: Live Job TTL matches the reviewed fixture; helper observes Job AND dependent Pod disappearance without deleting them itself. Not an exclusive-cause TTL-controller audit. Manual cleanup, Job-only deletion or missing/changed live TTL does not satisfy this fact.

facts.title: Backup / workload / uninstall impact reviewed
facts.description: Backups outside Git; workloads stopped through Factory; killall/uninstall host-wide network effects and exact approved K3S_DATA_DIR reviewed.

facts.title: Managed installation ownership observed
facts.description: Explicit installation observation, not inferred from request; readiness additionally needs exact managed verification.

facts.title: Owned service inactive observed
facts.description: For explicit reviewed start only; no automatic restart or recovery apply.

No upstream source copied or distributed; no upstream license was exposed in the reference checkout. No review-product states, hooks, credentials or classifier calls. Hapsland pins Bend 2.0.36; this producer separately pins 2.0.37 and does not validate Hapsland artifacts.
